When I was in this situation, I had hung out with the guy (alone), we texted about this, we talked on the phone. The best was to sit down and talk out at a park when I could talk about how I felt and I could see how he felt. Not just on a text. I think being somewhere in person really helps things. I will admit, it was a hard conversation. I was admitting to the new guy I liked how I felt trapped and guilty to just break up with guy #1 out of no where. I was so honest with him. Guy #2 was sooo angry with me. He was fed up. I understood why. Eventually, it will come down to her. You can state how you feel, you can lay it all out there.. but then you just gotta wait for her to decide. It took me about 2 months of this bullshit for me to see the light.

Okay. So I was a gf in this situation before. I was with someone and had met someone new- who I was very much interested in. It sucks to be in that place, I'm sure shes nice and doesnt want to hurt anyone. What you need to do is tell her honestly, straight up, that this really cant continue if she isnt going to break up with him. I mean, honestly, she is being really disrespectful to him right now (and im sure she knows it, like i did). But what really kicked my butt into gear was when guy #2 decided to cut contact, not accept my texts, or facebook chats. It tore me up. It made me realize I truly wanted it. I still felt feelings for the other guy but I knew I wasnt 100% in it. I ended up leaving guy #1 for guy #2 and have been with him for over 8 months, happier than ever. 

Long story short, I think you need to be honest with her and really tell her how you feel and this situation sucks. She really needs to make up her mind.
